title: NASA's Uranus fact sheet: obliquity 97.77 degrees
summary: The sheet lists Uranus's obliquity to orbit as 97.77 degrees, mass 86.811 × 10^24 kg, sidereal orbit 30,685.400 days, equatorial radius at the 1-bar level 25,559 km, and 28 natural satellites.
body: The sheet lists Uranus's obliquity to orbit as 97.77 degrees, mass 86.811 × 10^24 kg, sidereal orbit 30,685.400 days, equatorial radius at the 1-bar level 25,559 km, and 28 natural satellites. It prints the sidereal rotation period as −17.24 hours with an asterisk, and this card does not expand that asterisk. It lists a planetary ring system as Yes. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last updated on the page: 2024-10-02.
